scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p backend/tsconfig.json && npm run check:cbc
scripts.lint: biome check apps/api apps/web/src packages tests scripts/*.ts
scripts.format: biome check --write apps/api apps/web/src packages tests scripts/*.ts
scripts.build: npm ci --prefix frontend/website --ignore-scripts && npm run typecheck && vite build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts && esbuild apps/api/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/api.mjs
scripts.integration:build: npm run typecheck && vite build --config frontend/website/vite.config.ts
scripts.integration:dev: npm run integration:build && node --import tsx backend/local/server.ts
scripts.integration:worker:migrate: node --import tsx scripts/prepare-integration-migrations.ts && wrangler d1 migrations apply dhaaga-integration --local --config backend/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.build:frontend: npm run check:frontend && vite build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts
